description: Na₂Co₂O₃ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.41 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.41 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with eight CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with four CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.54 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.45 Å. There are four inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra, corners with five CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with three NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-46°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.01 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two CoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-55°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.06 Å. In the third Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra, corners with five CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with three NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-46°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.01 Å. In the fourth Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two CoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-55°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.06 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and three Co atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Co₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 1°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and three Co atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Co₃ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-58°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Co atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and three Co atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Co₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 1°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na and three Co atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Co₃ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-58°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Co atoms.
